mapper.select: SELECT SUM(COALESCE(ms.total_send_count, 0)) AS total_send_count, SUM(COALESCE(ms.total_success_count, 0)) AS total_success_count, SUM(COALESCE(ms.billing_cost, 0)) AS billing_cost, SUM(COALESCE(ms.max_cost, 0)) AS max_cost FROM message_stat ms WHERE

WITH today_window AS ( SELECT CAST(TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at, CAST(TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE) + 1 AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at FROM dual ), today_histories AS ( SELECT sh.* FROM send_history sh CROSS JOIN today_window tw WHERE NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND sh.status = 'SENT' AND sh.completed_at >= tw.start_at AND sh.completed_at < tw.end_at ), target_costs AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(st.cost, 0)), 0) AS max_cost FROM today_histories th INNER JOIN send_target st ON st.send_history_id = th.id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ), success_costs AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(th.actual_cost, 0)), 0) AS billing_cost FROM today_histories th ) SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(th.total_target_count, 0)), 0) AS total_send_count, NVL(SUM(NVL(th.success_count, 0)), 0) AS total_success_count, NVL(SUM(NVL(th.fail_count, 0)), 0) AS total_fail_count, MAX(success_costs.billing_cost) AS billing_cost, MAX(target_costs.max_cost) AS max_cost FROM today_histories th CROSS JOIN target_costs CROSS JOIN success_costs

SELECT trend.stat_date, trend.total_send_count, trend.total_success_count, trend.billing_cost, trend.max_cost FROM ( SELECT ms.stat_date, ms.total_send_count, ms.total_success_count, ms.billing_cost, ms.max_cost FROM message_stat ms WHERE ORDER BY ms.stat_date DESC FETCH FIRST 7 ROWS ONLY ) trend ORDER BY trend.stat_date

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.joined_at < SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7' DAY AND ( c.last_active_at IS NULL OR c.last_active_at >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSTIMESTAMP, -12) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normal_customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.joined_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_customer_count FROM customer c WHERE NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND c.joined_at <= SYSTIMESTAMP

SELECT sh.id, sh.title, sh.purpose, sh.total_target_count, sh.success_count, sh.fail_count, sh.status, sh.scheduled_at, sh.completed_at, sh.created_at FROM send_history sh WHERE sh.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN sh.completed_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, sh.completed_at DESC, sh.id DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
